title: Recruitment application model and status workflow
summary: Applications against open APES CIC recruitment roles can be stored with a validated status workflow from submitted through review outcomes.
changes: Add the RecruitmentApplication model, migration, and factory with status states submitted, under_review, shortlisted, rejected, accepted, withdrawn, and closed.
Enforce validated status transitions and block applications against draft or closed recruitment roles.
Register an ownership and staff review policy so applicants own their rows and staff with review-applications can review non-terminal applications.
Cover model, factory, policy, open-role gating, and transition rules with feature tests.
version_rationale: Patch release on the v0.34.x line: the application model and status workflow build on the public roles board from 0.34.2 without shipping public apply or staff review UI yet.
validation: PHPUnit RecruitmentApplicationWorkflowTest, RecruitmentRoleWorkflowTest, and PublicRecruitmentBoardTest pass for model, policy, and related recruitment coverage.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
composer pre-pr-verify (or equivalent local verify) on the PR branch before merge.
known_limitations: Public apply and staff application review UI are not included; those ship in a later 0.34.x patch.
Recruitment remains APES CIC only (not Shelter or Pet Care Clinic).
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to remove the RecruitmentApplication model, policy, and recruitment_applications migration from the live app.
provenance: RecruitmentApplication model and status workflow for issue #221, pull request #244.
